insights.insight: Ad tech charges $5–$150 CPA for modeled attribution. This protocol settles verified purchase confirmation at ~$0.10 per receipt — a 50–200x cost delta that is structural, not a promotional rate.

Walmart, Amazon, and Target — the three largest US retailers by revenue — all hold meaningful receipt counts in the 14-day window. Target's entry at 28 receipts displaced Best Buy entirely, confirming the protocol has crossed the density threshold for the full big-box tier.

The 14-day window accounts for $109,747 of $484,522 in all-time protocol GMV — 22.6% of total volume in the most recent two weeks. The protocol is not running on historical momentum; current acquisition is accelerating.

Receipt flow now spans grocery, big-box, specialty retail, discount, online marketplaces, and peer-to-peer resale. For a brand marketer building audience segments, that is the complete purchase funnel — not a single-channel sample.

insights.topic: Online purchase confirmation as primary receipt vector
insights.insight: DKIM vendors include Amazon, Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Suno — confirming that email purchase receipts from digital transactions are a core data source alongside physical retail, which matters for brands running D2C or SaaS alongside physical SKUs.

The 'Unknown' category carries an average ticket of ~$91 across 145 receipts in the 14-day window — the highest of any resolved category. Resolving this classification would materially shift the retail-versus-services split and could surface a high-value audience segment currently invisible.
